self_review: Challenged every NA against actual Worker scope rather than missing imports. rightkit-http was checked against live Listmonk fetch: it is Workers-native, not a Rust bridge. @rightkit/logs was checked against console.error: owner requires a Tauri invoke host, absent here. @rightkit/qa, @rightkit/release, @rightkit/update, @rightkit/git, and build-control policy were checked against Wrangler scripts/config and found outside this request-only Worker. KV is Cloudflare-host storage, so SQLite/settings/fs/sync substitutions are neither host-compatible nor active scope. All Rust and Swift rows remain NA because no compatible runtime or bridge exists; no desktop adoption was inferred.
